items.title: Willie Hightower Interview, 1958-06-03
items.q: And I always did believe in playing, like you see Lionel Hampton, them doing, say something when they do.

ctx.x: And he laughed. He says, no. He says, Joe Oliver is all right. Freddie Kepler's all right. He said, but you want to learn music. Oh, I said, I'll learn all right. He said, but you better watch yourself. And he couldn't talk and he went on down the street. Well, every evening he'd pass by there going home, not late at night, but it'd be in the early part of the night. I'd see him maybe three or four times a week. So Roy knew music. But Roy never coaxed me with the music end of it. Roy, to teach me how to play,…
